name: boot_main

globals.name: D_800580A8
globals.evidence: Authored extern unsigned int; receives a single 32-bit load of CdlFILE.pos, containing the four packed CdlLOC minute/second/sector/track bytes, followed by a word store at 0x8001220C. This is resident CD-position storage, not overlay data.

globals.name: D_800580AC
globals.evidence: Authored extern unsigned long, 32 bits on the target; receives CdlFILE.size from stack offset 0x54 via a word store at 0x80012214. The SDK export identifies size as u_long. This is resident CD-file size storage.

function_evidence: boot_main takes no observed arguments and has no observed return value: startup calls it without preparing argument registers, and its epilogue does not establish v0. Current Ghidra pseudocode was adapted with its SDK CdlFILE/CdlLOC layouts. The initializer at 0x8001C0F4 accepts a0 pointing to sixteen writable 32-bit words and a1=1; it clears all 64 bytes and returns 3, ignored here. The loader at 0x800123F8 receives state[0] and state[1] in a0/a1 and returns a 32-bit size/address value stored to state[1]. The loaded overlay entry at 0x8005AB6C receives the state pointer in a0 and returns the next mode in v0; INIT.BIN confirms pointer use and returns 6, while the caller exits on -1. Other state-word meanings and the signed/address interpretation of state[1] remain uncertain. CdSearchFile receives a 24-byte CdlFILE and the existing INIT.BIN path; the position is copied as one packed word. Boundaries are 0x800121B8 inclusive through 0x8001228C exclusive: preceding startup metadata is separate, the sole incoming call targets the entry, and the next function starts its own prologue. SDK exit retains its existing resident build symbol func_80044938. Focused object diagnostics report 100 percent; containing-file acceptance is reserved for the supervisor.
